grades.quote: For XLEN≥64 only, instructions are provided to move bit patterns between the floating-point and integer registers.
grades.reason: Directly describes FMV.X.D and FMV.D.X as bit-preserving transfers in both directions, for XLEN≥64.
Transfers control/status register contents, not floating-point bit representations between integer and floating-point data registers.
Describes numerical conversions with rounding, not raw-bit transfers.
Transfers single bits between floating-point and condition-flag registers, not integer registers.
